HUD FONT SUBSET MANIFEST
========================

Source of truth for tests/test_hud_fonts.py: the vendored woff2 cmaps must
match this exactly. Keep a single --unicodes= line (the test parses one).

Fonts (SIL OFL 1.1, licenses alongside):
  Share Tech Mono  400          -> share-tech-mono.woff2
  IBM Plex Mono    400/500/600  -> ibm-plex-mono-{400,500,600}.woff2
The .woff2 files are pyftsubset cuts of the Google Fonts upstreams, not the
full fonts.

pyftsubset request (identical for every face):
  --unicodes=U+0020-007E,U+00B0,U+00B7,U+25B2,U+25BC,U+25C6,U+25B8,U+25C2,U+27F3
  --flavor=woff2 --layout-features='*' --no-hinting --desubroutinize

Present in every subset: Basic Latin (U+0020-007E, incl. digits and %), ° (U+00B0), · (U+00B7).

FALLBACK_SYMBOLS (requested but absent from both fonts, so not vendored):
  ◆ ▸ ◂ ▲ ▼ ⟳
  U+25C6 U+25B8 U+25C2 U+25B2 U+25BC U+27F3
  The HUD draws these as SVG; never emit them as text.
